error_reporting_evidence.source_kind: real user-reported Beekeeper Studio connection failure screenshot
observations: The connection form and entered host, port, user, and password remain visible after failure.
A persistent inline error card appears directly below Test and Connect.
The card uses an error icon, the heading There was a problem, and the exact database error message.
The error can be dismissed without clearing the connection form.
Test and Connect remain available so the user can correct the data and repeat the same action.
error_reporting_evidence.scope: This screenshot proves the visible failure presentation; the successful connection motion separately proves recovery to a connected database result.
